how_to.title: How to Download from Pinterest
how_to.subtitle: Follow these 3 easy steps to save any video, image, or GIF in seconds.
how_to.mobile_step1_desc: Open the Pinterest App, locate the video or image, tap the ••• (Three Dots) icon or Share button, and select "Copy Link".
how_to.mobile_step2_desc: Open pinxtract.com in Safari or Chrome, tap the "Paste" button in our search bar, and hit "Download".
how_to.mobile_step3_desc: Choose your preferred quality (1080p, 720p HD MP4, or Original Image) and tap Download to save it straight to your device folder.
how_to.desktop_step1_desc: Go to pinterest.com on Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge. Click any Pin and copy the browser address bar URL.
how_to.desktop_step2_desc: Paste the link into PinXtract. Our high-speed cloud resolver extracts all available media streams (MP4, WEBP, JPG) in under 2 seconds.
how_to.desktop_step3_desc: Click any resolution button. The file is piped directly to your Downloads folder with a clean, organized filename.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about downloading Pinterest videos, images, and GIFs.
faq.q1: Can I download videos from Pinterest for free?
faq.a1: Yes, 100% free! PinXtract lets you download unlimited Pinterest videos, GIFs, and images without requiring any subscription, registration, or credit card.
faq.a2: No. Unlike other social media downloaders, PinXtract provides the clean original MP4 video stream directly from Pinterest's CDN servers with zero added watermarks or logos.
faq.q3: How do I save Pinterest videos to my iPhone Camera Roll?
faq.a3: On your iPhone, copy the link from the Pinterest App, open Safari, paste the link on PinXtract, and tap Download. Safari will prompt "Do you want to download...?". Tap Download. Open your Files app (or Safari downloads), tap the video, tap the Share icon, and select "Save Video" to save directly to your Camera Roll.
faq.q4: What video resolutions and formats are supported?
faq.a4: PinXtract supports 1080p Full HD, 720p HD, and 480p SD in universal standard MP4 format with AAC audio. For images, we support Original 4K/2K JPEG, PNG, and animated GIF formats.
faq.q5: Where do downloaded files go on my computer or Android?
faq.a5: On Windows and Mac, downloaded files are automatically placed in your computer's Downloads folder. On Android, files are saved in your internal storage Downloads folder and automatically appear in Google Photos / Gallery.
faq.q6: Can I download Pinterest boards and profile pins in bulk?
faq.a6: Yes. PinXtract can parse public Pinterest boards, ideas collections, and story carousels up to 50 pins per request, allowing you to preview and download all slides.
faq.q7: Does PinXtract store copies of downloaded files?
faq.a7: No. PinXtract does not host or store any user media. Media files are streamed directly from Pinterest's public content delivery networks (CDNs) straight to your device.
